'''Devry''' was an old [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sector [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] garrison on [[Shramar]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], but he had some kind of accord with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and for this he was killed by [[Nina Galfridian]].
